tasks.short: Meet management and advisers to gather evidence, challenge explanations and discuss examination findings.

steps.what: Review examination evidence and prepare questions for management and advisers.

loop.input: Selected examination evidence and finding register.
loop.output: Meeting brief with source-linked questions and unresolved evidence gaps.
loop.check: Each factual statement links to accessible evidence; examiner checks sensitive questions.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass per meeting; unsupported items return to the examiner.
loop.why_not_simpler: Questions depend on conflicting explanations and free-text evidence; templates cover only the structure.

steps.what: Arrange attendance, timing and secure circulation of the meeting brief.
Lead discussion, probe explanations and distinguish commitments from tentative statements.
Turn discussion notes into minutes, evidence requests and proposed action entries.

loop.input: Examiner's discussion notes and proposed commitments.
loop.output: Draft meeting record separating statements, disputed points, requests and commitments.
loop.check: Every entry traces to notes; no inferred agreement, deadline or owner.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass; ambiguous commitments remain explicitly unresolved.
loop.why_not_simpler: Notes use varied wording and contain qualifications that field rules cannot reliably interpret.

steps.what: Check disputed wording, commitments and permitted recipients before approving the meeting record.
Circulate the approved record and enter agreed requests into the examination tracker.

tasks.design: A configured flow in the {WORKFLOW} coordinates meetings through the {CALENDAR} and distributes approved records through the {EMAIL}. Two bounded drafting steps use evidence in the {DOCS}; approved requests become linked entries in the {PROJECT}. The examiner leads the discussion, and the lead examiner approves the record and recipients before release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scheduling was feasible already, but confidential evidence, varied notes and disputed commitments made preparation and follow-up costly to connect.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing scheduling and approval features handle coordination. AI-assisted development reduces connector work, while bounded drafting can produce source-linked preparation and minutes.
tasks.still_hard: Power dynamics, legal privilege, evasive answers and agreement about what was actually promised require people.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner notices hesitation, asks difficult follow-up questions and preserves trust without softening findings.

ambition.what: A pre-meeting evidence-gap brief for management discussions.

tasks.altitude: The week contains less scheduling and rewriting, while substantive meetings remain. The examiner gains earlier visibility of evidence gaps; formal decision rights do not change.

reach.task: Prepare focused evidence requests before a compliance review.
reach.learn: Learn regulatory evidence standards, confidentiality boundaries and neutral question wording.

evidence.claim: Scheduling, controlled circulation and action tracking can use configured workflows.
Moody's Credit Memo demonstrates drafting from deal documents and templates; meeting preparation is an analogous use.
Discussion leadership and interpretation of disputed commitments remain human work.

assumptions: The role is an internal financial examination or assurance role in a regulated institution with 200 to 2,000 staff.
The examiner has no independent statutory enforcement powers.
Discussion notes are available; recording meetings is not required.
Automated invitations use an examiner-maintained participant list; substantive correspondence requires an approved record.
Build ranges are working days for one team and include access review, GDPR assessment and any consultation required by national rules.
unknowns: Which meeting records contain privileged material.
Whether external participants may receive secure document links.
Which role approves minutes and evidence requests.
Whether proposed tooling constitutes employee monitoring under applicable national rules.
research_questions: How often do participants dispute recorded commitments?
Which existing scheduling and document approval features cover the required controls?
new_work: Review generated questions and draft minutes.
Resolve ambiguous commitments and disputed wording.
Maintain participant access, circulation rules and action mappings.
Check that sensitive source material is excluded from inappropriate briefs.

tasks.short: Recommend proportionate actions to remedy compliance failures and protect institutional solvency.

steps.what: Collect findings, financial evidence and applicable requirements for the issue.
Calculate exposures and compare financial measures with applicable limits.
Draft corrective options with supporting evidence, dependencies and unresolved questions.

loop.input: Approved requirements, findings, evidence and deterministically calculated impacts.
loop.output: Corrective options with citations, dependencies and uncertainty labels.
loop.check: Citations resolve to supplied sources; figures match the impact schedule; examiner checks applicability.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per issue; missing legal support returns to the examiner.
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative findings require contextual synthesis; rules handle calculations but cannot formulate every remedy.

steps.what: Assess proportionality, legal interpretation, solvency effects and unintended consequences.
Challenge feasibility and urgency with management and legal counsel.
Approve the examination recommendation, escalation level and intended recipients.
Issue the approved recommendation and register requested corrective actions.

tasks.design: A job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} collects linked evidence from the {ERP}, {DOCS} and {PROJECT}, then calculates impacts with versioned rules. A bounded drafting step prepares options in the {DOCS}; the examiner assesses them and the lead examiner approves the recommendation. The {WORKFLOW} issues the approved version and creates action entries in the {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence and financial calculations sat apart from regulatory interpretation. Maintaining reliable mappings, document links and approval history was expensive.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes narrow evidence integrations and calculation generators cheaper to build. Source-constrained drafting helps prepare options without delegating legal interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Regulatory applicability, proportionality, stressed assumptions and remedies with competing financial consequences remain difficult.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner decides whether a technically compliant remedy is credible, proportionate and sufficient to protect solvency.

ambition.what: Weekly reprioritisation of open corrective actions using updated exposure measures.

tasks.altitude: The examiner spends less time assembling evidence and more time testing remedies against current exposures. They can propose priority changes more often; management retains implementation and resource authority.

reach.task: Compare corrective options under adverse financial scenarios.
reach.learn: Learn scenario assumptions, capital constraints and sensitivity interpretation.

evidence.claim: Evidence extraction and numerical checks can support reviewer sign-off.
Moody's Credit Memo drafts financial narratives from structured analysis, documents and templates.
Deterministic calculations need source reconciliation; generated financial arithmetic is not a reliable substitute.
Selecting proportionate compliance and solvency remedies requires accountable professional judgement.

assumptions: The institution maintains a requirement register whose applicability and effective dates are approved by qualified people.
Recommendations do not themselves change customer contracts, capital positions or lending decisions.
Financial calculations use approved definitions and explicitly recorded assumptions.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply; obligations depend on the deployed use. This design does not perform natural-person credit scoring.
Build ranges are working days for a limited issue family and include access approval and any consultation required by national rules.
unknowns: Which regulatory requirements and internal limits apply to each entity.
Who may approve, issue and implement recommendations.
Whether financial exposures can be reconciled across source systems.
Whether existing tools already provide the necessary action and approval controls.
research_questions: Which recommendation types share stable calculations and evidence requirements?
How often does legal interpretation change the proposed remedy?
What evidence is required before an action can be marked effective?
new_work: Review drafted options and unsupported assertions.
Investigate failed reconciliations and stale evidence.
Maintain calculation rules and approved requirement versions.
Audit recommendation releases and action-register links.

tasks.short: Prepare evidence-backed examination reports on financial soundness, compliance failures and corrective recommendations.

steps.what: Assemble financial records, examination workpapers, findings and approved recommendations.
Reconcile figures and prepare supporting schedules and exhibits.
Draft report sections linking findings, financial conditions and recommended remedies.

loop.input: Versioned evidence pack, verified schedules and approved recommendations.
loop.output: Draft report with source-linked statements and figures inserted from verified schedules.
loop.check: Every figure matches a schedule; factual assertions have evidence links; unresolved exceptions remain visible.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per section; unsupported sections stay incomplete for the examiner.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates generate tables, but explaining relationships among narrative findings requires bounded synthesis.

steps.what: Assess materiality, resolve exceptions and refine conclusions about safety and soundness.
Approve report conclusions, recommendations, disclosures and distribution.
Issue the approved report to authorised recipients.
Archive the issued report, source versions and approval history.

tasks.design: A versioned job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} gathers evidence from the {ERP}, {DOCS} and {PROJECT}, reconciles figures and generates schedules. A bounded drafting step fills the report template in the {DOCS}, with figures supplied by code and assertions linked to evidence. The {WORKFLOW} releases and archives the approved report with its evidence and approval history.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated copying across workpapers, schedules and narrative reports made source tracing fragile. Templates could format reports but could not reliably connect varied findings to evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic generators can populate figures and exhibits, while bounded drafting handles narrative sections. AI-assisted coding reduces the effort needed to build and maintain source mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Materiality, contradictory evidence, missing records and defensible conclusions about institutional soundness remain expensive.
tasks.human_edge: The examiner distinguishes an isolated documentation defect from a material weakness and writes conclusions they can defend.

ambition.what: An evidence-linked interim examination brief between formal reporting cycles.

tasks.altitude: The examiner spends less time copying figures and formatting exhibits, and more time resolving material findings. They can prepare interim briefs without a full report rebuild; report approval rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare reconciled workpapers and evidence-linked assurance reports.
reach.learn: Learn sampling limits, evidence sufficiency and workpaper review conventions.

reach.task: Maintain validated financial exhibits for examination reporting.
reach.learn: Learn data lineage, reporting definitions and reproducible calculation controls.

evidence.claim: DataSnipper supports evidence extraction and financial statement checks with human sign-off.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reported statement tick-and-tie falling from eight to two hours; this is a vendor-reported case, not a forecast here.
Moody's Credit Memo demonstrates document-grounded financial narrative drafting.
The digest's spreadsheet-agent benchmark supports validating arithmetic outside narrative generation.

assumptions: A pilot covers one report family with an approved template and stable financial definitions.
Source versions and evidence links can be retained under the institution's retention policy.
Failed reconciliations remain visible and prevent affected sections from being treated as final.
GDPR and EU AI Act applicability are assessed for the actual deployment; confidential evidence remains access-controlled.
Build ranges are working days and include access, retention review and consultation where national rules require it.
unknowns: Which reports require regulatory filing rather than controlled distribution.
Whether source records have stable identifiers and usable exports.
Which materiality judgements require additional review.
Which retention periods and legal holds apply.
research_questions: Which exhibits can be generated entirely from reconciled source data?
How much report rewriting follows changes in materiality or management responses?
Which sections lack sufficient evidence for source-constrained drafting?
new_work: Review generated narrative and evidence citations.
Resolve reconciliation failures and missing source versions.
Maintain templates, calculation definitions and source mappings.
Check archive completeness and recipient permissions.

tasks.short: Coordinate remedies for weak portfolios, capital, earnings and troubled accounts, then verify their effectiveness.

steps.what: Collect portfolio, capital, earnings and troubled-account evidence from finance and lending records.
Model losses, concentrations, capital effects and recovery scenarios.
Prepare recovery options using account terms, scenarios and approved recommendations.

loop.input: Account documents, verified scenarios and approved recommendations.
loop.output: Recovery options with source-linked constraints, dependencies and open questions.
loop.check: Figures match scenarios; contractual assertions cite supplied clauses; no invented borrower commitments.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per case; missing terms or conflicts return to the examiner.
loop.why_not_simpler: Account terms and remedies vary in free text; deterministic templates cannot explain all dependencies.

steps.what: Select a preferred remedy and identify residual financial and compliance risks.
Agree feasible actions, resources and conditions with management and responsible teams.
Approve recovery actions within delegated authority and escalate actions beyond limits.
Enter authorised account adjustments in the {OTHER} banking transaction system.
Refresh measures and track implementation against recovery conditions.
Decide whether evidence supports closure, further remediation or escalation.

tasks.design: A job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reconciles the {ERP} with the {OTHER} banking transaction system and generates scenarios from approved assumptions. A bounded drafting step prepares recovery options in the {DOCS}; people select, agree and approve remedies, while configured transaction controls support authorised implementation. The {BI} and {PROJECT} track outcomes, with human approval required for finding closure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Portfolio, account and finance records used different definitions and identifiers. Bespoke scenario work and sensitive transaction authority made a single automated resolution process impractical.
tasks.enabler_now: Narrow integrations, reusable scenario calculations and configured approval controls can now be built with less engineering effort. Bounded drafting can organise account constraints without controlling recovery decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Recovery depends on borrower behaviour, collateral value, market conditions, contractual rights and uncertain loss assumptions. Capital measures and external commitments require separate authorised processes.
tasks.human_edge: People judge whether a remedy is economically credible, negotiate acceptable conditions and recognise when apparent recovery masks continuing risk.

ambition.what: Weekly review of deteriorating recovery plans using refreshed financial indicators.

tasks.altitude: The examiner receives updated scenarios and recovery indicators with less manual assembly. They can bring deterioration to management sooner; lending, transaction and capital decision rights remain with authorised roles.

reach.task: Assess repayment capacity and compare troubled-account recovery options.
reach.learn: Learn cash-flow analysis, collateral uncertainty and restructuring constraints.

reach.task: Assess liquidity and capital consequences of recovery plans.
reach.learn: Learn funding constraints, capital definitions and treasury approval limits.

evidence.claim: Structured financial analysis can support document-grounded option drafting.
Hawk demonstrates monitoring with reasons per alert and human review; recovery monitoring is an analogous application.
Natural-person creditworthiness AI falls within a high-risk category, subject to scope and exceptions.
Credit scoring can constitute an automated decision when it plays a determining role in a lender's decision.
Recovery choices, major account changes and closure decisions require accountable financial judgement.

assumptions: The {OTHER} slot denotes the banking transaction and loan-record system.
The examiner coordinates assurance and remediation; authorised operational roles execute changes.
Scenario calculations use approved assumptions and do not generate personal creditworthiness scores.
Configured implementation initially covers internal account adjustments with approved transaction instructions.
External contract changes, lending decisions and capital transactions follow their own authorised processes.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply. Any later natural-person creditworthiness use needs a separate scope assessment and applicable safeguards.
Build ranges are working days for a narrow portfolio pilot, including access controls and any consultation required by national rules.
unknowns: Which portfolios, account types and financial entities are in scope.
Whether source systems support configured approvals and controlled adjustment entry.
Which remedies require borrower consent, legal review or regulatory engagement.
Which roles hold transaction, lending and capital authority.
Whether consumer or sole-trader accounts would introduce creditworthiness assessment.
research_questions: Which recovery actions have stable instructions and existing transaction controls?
Which scenario assumptions most often change the preferred remedy?
Which indicators distinguish implementation completion from effective risk reduction?
new_work: Review drafted recovery options and contractual citations.
Validate scenario assumptions and investigate reconciliation failures.
Maintain source mappings, limits and monitoring thresholds.
Assess deterioration alerts and verify evidence before closing findings.

role.altitude: The financial examiner spends less time assembling evidence, reproducing calculations and preparing paperwork. More of the week goes to challenging explanations, evaluating remedies and verifying whether risk has actually fallen; formal enforcement and transaction authority do not expand.
reach: Credit analysis: compare repayment capacity and recovery options using defensible scenarios.
Financial risk: connect examination findings to capital, concentration and loss sensitivities.
Audit: strengthen evidence sufficiency, reproducibility and review trails.
Business intelligence: define validated indicators that support examination decisions.
skills_to_grow: Review of generated text against evidence.
Approval controls, confidentiality and access design.
role.ambitious_version: Provide a rolling, evidence-linked view of unresolved financial weaknesses, with refreshed scenarios and focused management discussions between formal examinations.
